label: Blind sample 083: Hansen forest loss 2019, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.10 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.15 to −0.04). The same test was run on 8 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.11). Counted by gap size instead, 1 of the 8 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.22). But: only 8 usable control cells (need 20).

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar passes every test on its own: greenness (NDVI) −0.10, interval −0.15 to −0.04.

notes: only 7 cells share the area's land cover (tree cover); land-cover filter relaxed
elevation filter relaxed (too few cells would remain)
ranked by pre-event similarity; kept the best 8
